title: Haseltine's novel Out of Time hiding truths

tellings.quote: former director of NSA research, Eric Haseltine, who I had on my show. He wrote a a {quote} {unquote} fiction book. I think it was called Out of Time.

plain: A former director of research at the NSA, the US government's electronic spying agency, named Eric Haseltine wrote a book that Jesse Michels calls "fiction" in air quotes, a novel he thinks was titled Out of Time. Michels, who has interviewed Haseltine on his show, suggests the novel may carry real truths dressed up as a story, coming from someone with inside knowledge.
